searchText: Here's lodestar's development update in case I can't wake up to join the call (breakout is 6am my time): We have rebased focil on top of devnet 8 stuff https://github.com/ChainSafe/lodestar/pull/9842 and this is the focil-devnet-0 branch for interop purpose cc. <@412614104222531604> . It should include all Heze stuff from alpha.13, exeuction apis, and the unmerged beacon apis. Anything that will go into alpha.14 are not implemented. I am able to run two lodestar/ethrex pairs on local kurtosis and I am able to see ILs gossiping and finalized. cc. <@281967554572976128> Happy to run more client pairs if available FOCIL 40
